title: mdwright diagnostic (JSON Lines, v2)
description: One record per line in the output of `mdwright check --format=json`.

schema_version.description: Schema version. The literal `2` for this schema; future incompatible changes will bump this number.

path.description: Path of the file being linted, as supplied on the CLI. For stdin input the value is `<stdin>`.

severity.description: Diagnostic severity. `error` is non-advisory and fails `mdwright check --check`; `advisory` does not. `warning` is reserved for future use.

description.description: One-line summary of what the rule flags.

url.description: Repository-relative path to the rule's long-form documentation page.

line.description: 1-indexed line number of the diagnostic's first byte.

column.description: 1-indexed codepoint column of the diagnostic's first byte.

span_start.description: Byte offset (0-indexed) of the first byte of the offending region.

span_end.description: Byte offset one past the last byte of the offending region.

snippet.description: The source line containing the diagnostic, without its trailing newline. Multi-line spans are clipped to the first line.

message.description: Human-readable, single-sentence description of the problem.

replacement.description: Text to substitute for the source region `source.span_start..source.span_end`.

safe.description: Whether the replacement is safe to apply without manual review. `mdwright fix` applies only safe fixes; unsafe ones are surfaced as suggestions.

fix.description: Optional automatic fix. Omitted when no fix is available.
